Using the defined criteria—ABO compatibility, zero HLA mismatches across A/B/DR, and a size compatibility score from 0.9 to 1.1—there are **no Optimal Donor-Recipient Matches** in the data. Thus, there are no pairs to list, and every ethnicity combination has a count of zero.

| Donor ethnicity \ Recipient ethnicity | African | Asian | Caucasian | Hispanic | Other |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| African | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Asian | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Caucasian | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Hispanic | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Other | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 |

```sql
WITH match_metrics AS (
    SELECT
        tm.match_rec_registry,
        json_extract_string(d.physicalstats, '$.Ethnicity') AS donor_ethnicity,
        rd.ethn_grp AS recipient_ethnicity,
        CASE
            WHEN LEFT(d.blood_class, 2) = 'AB' THEN TRUE
            WHEN LEFT(d.blood_class, 1) = 'O' THEN TRUE
            WHEN LEFT(rd.blood_class, 2) = 'AB' THEN TRUE
            WHEN LEFT(rd.blood_class, 1) = LEFT(d.blood_class, 1) THEN TRUE
            ELSE FALSE
        END AS abo_compatible,
        (CASE WHEN h.hla_a_val <> CAST(json_extract_string(ri.hlaprofile, '$.Hla_A_Val') AS REAL) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
       + CASE WHEN h.hla_b_val <> CAST(json_extract_string(ri.hlaprofile, '$.Hla_B_Val') AS REAL) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
       + CASE WHEN h.hla_dr_val <> CAST(json_extract_string(ri.hlaprofile, '$.Hla_Dr_Val') AS REAL) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS hla_mismatches,
        1 - ABS(
            CAST(json_extract_string(d.physicalstats, '$.Bmi_Value') AS REAL)
            / rd.bmi_val - 1
        ) AS size_score
    FROM transplant_matching tm
    JOIN demographics d
        ON d.contrib_registry = tm.donor_ref_reg
    JOIN recipients_demographics rd
        ON rd.recip_registry = tm.recip_ref_reg
    JOIN hla_info h
        ON h.immu_don_registry = tm.donor_ref_reg
    JOIN recipients_immunology ri
        ON ri.immu_recip_registry = tm.recip_ref_reg
),
optimal_matches AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM match_metrics
    WHERE abo_compatible
      AND hla_mismatches = 0
      AND size_score BETWEEN 0.9 AND 1.1
),
ethnicities AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT json_extract_string(physicalstats, '$.Ethnicity') AS ethnicity
    FROM demographics
    UNION
    SELECT DISTINCT ethn_grp
    FROM recipients_demographics
)
SELECT
    donor.ethnicity AS donor_ethnicity,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE om.recipient_ethnicity = 'African') AS African,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE om.recipient_ethnicity = 'Asian') AS Asian,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE om.recipient_ethnicity = 'Caucasian') AS Caucasian,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE om.recipient_ethnicity = 'Hispanic') AS Hispanic,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE om.recipient_ethnicity = 'Other') AS Other
FROM ethnicities donor
LEFT JOIN optimal_matches om
    ON om.donor_ethnicity = donor.ethnicity
GROUP BY donor.ethnicity
ORDER BY donor.ethnicity;

There are **198** patients with a positive crossmatch; **22** meet the official **High Risk** criteria (PRA ≥ 80 and DSA Positive). For patients with a recorded match attempt, the last attempt date is **2025-02-19**; **9** have no matching attempt recorded, so their date is NULL. The query below returns the full list, ordered by PRA score from highest to lowest.

```sql
WITH last_match AS (
    SELECT
        recip_ref_reg,
        MAX(TRY_CAST(created_ts AS TIMESTAMP)) AS last_attempt_ts
    FROM transplant_matching
    GROUP BY recip_ref_reg
)
SELECT
    i.immu_recip_registry AS patient_id,
    i.pra_score,
    CASE
        WHEN LOWER(TRIM(i.dsa_state)) = 'positive' THEN 'Yes'
        WHEN LOWER(TRIM(i.dsa_state)) = 'negative' THEN 'No'
        ELSE 'Unknown'
    END AS has_dsa,
    CASE
        WHEN i.pra_score >= 80
             AND LOWER(TRIM(i.dsa_state)) = 'positive'
        THEN 'High Risk'
        ELSE 'Standard Risk'
    END AS amr_risk,
    CAST(lm.last_attempt_ts AS DATE) AS last_match_attempt_date
FROM recipients_immunology AS i
LEFT JOIN last_match AS lm
    ON lm.recip_ref_reg = i.immu_recip_registry
WHERE LOWER(TRIM(i.cross_result)) = 'positive'
ORDER BY i.pra_score DESC NULLS LAST, patient_id;

Using the recorded organ ischemia time (`org_isch_time`) as total ischemia time, **Ground** has the highest average expected graft survival score. The averages ignore missing values for each measure.

| Transport method | Avg. total ischemia time (min) | Avg. expected graft survival score |
|---|---:|---:|
| Ground | 358.05 | 0.5384 |
| Commercial Air | 467.29 | 0.5066 |
| Helicopter | 363.88 | 0.4871 |
| Charter Air | 453.95 | 0.4631 |

These are associations in the completed-transplant records, not evidence that transport method caused the differences.

```sql
WITH completed AS (
  SELECT
    l.trans_method,
    TRY_CAST(regexp_extract(f.org_isch_time, '([0-9]+)', 1) AS DOUBLE)
      AS total_ischemia_min,
    r.egs_val
  FROM transplant_matching t
  JOIN logistics l
    ON l.log_match_registry = t.match_rec_registry
  LEFT JOIN function_and_recovery f
    ON f.recov_don_registry = t.donor_ref_reg
  LEFT JOIN risk_evaluation r
    ON r.risk_eval_registry = t.match_rec_registry
  WHERE lower(t.match_status) = 'completed'
)
SELECT
  trans_method,
  ROUND(AVG(total_ischemia_min), 2) AS avg_total_ischemia_time_min,
  ROUND(AVG(egs_val), 4) AS avg_expected_graft_survival_score
FROM completed
GROUP BY trans_method
ORDER BY avg_expected_graft_survival_score DESC,
         avg_total_ischemia_time_min ASC;

After splitting each patient’s `comorbid_detail` list and trimming the condition names, the database contains **four distinct nonblank conditions**, not five. I averaged each patient’s available surgical risk scores first, so patients with multiple matching records count equally in the condition average.

| Condition | Patients | Average surgical risk score |
|---|---:|---:|
| COPD | 235 | 0.4931 |
| Diabetes | 227 | 0.5159 |
| Heart Disease | 226 | 0.5344 |
| Hypertension | 217 | 0.5069 |

These averages describe the scores associated with patients who have each condition; they don’t establish that a condition causes higher surgical risk.

```sql
WITH patient_conditions AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
         c.clin_recip_registry AS patient_id,
         TRIM(u.condition) AS condition
  FROM clinical AS c,
       UNNEST(STRING_SPLIT(c.comorbid_detail, ',')) AS u(condition)
  WHERE c.comorbid_detail IS NOT NULL
    AND TRIM(u.condition) <> ''
),
top_conditions AS (
  SELECT condition, COUNT(DISTINCT patient_id) AS patient_count
  FROM patient_conditions
  GROUP BY condition
  ORDER BY patient_count DESC, condition
  LIMIT 5
),
patient_risk AS (
  SELECT recip_ref_reg AS patient_id,
         AVG(surg_risk_val) AS patient_avg_risk
  FROM risk_evaluation
  WHERE surg_risk_val IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY recip_ref_reg
)
SELECT tc.condition,
       tc.patient_count,
       ROUND(AVG(pr.patient_avg_risk), 4) AS avg_surgical_risk
FROM top_conditions AS tc
JOIN patient_conditions AS pc
  ON pc.condition = tc.condition
LEFT JOIN patient_risk AS pr
  ON pr.patient_id = pc.patient_id
GROUP BY tc.condition, tc.patient_count
ORDER BY tc.patient_count DESC, tc.condition;

I used **CER = estimated cost ÷ (recipient QoL score × 5 years)**, with a lower CER indicating a better bargain. Of 35 completed lung matches, 22 had usable cost and nonzero QoL data for ranking; the other 13 could not be assigned a CER.

| Group | Match ID | Donor ID | Recipient ID | CER ($/QALY) |
|---|---|---|---|---:|
| Best (1) | TM831296 | D494745 | R767148 | 672.05 |
| Best (1) | TM491235 | D340458 | R300062 | 878.17 |
| Worst (20) | TM923489 | D530861 | R836178 | 52,355.43 |

```sql
WITH cer_base AS (
    SELECT
        tm.match_rec_registry AS match_id,
        tm.donor_ref_reg AS donor_id,
        tm.recip_ref_reg AS recipient_id,
        try_cast(regexp_replace(cm.cost_est, '[^0-9.]', '', 'g') AS DOUBLE) AS cost_amount,
        re.qol_val AS qol_score
    FROM main.transplant_matching AS tm
    JOIN main.compatibility_metrics AS cm
        ON cm.match_comp_registry = tm.match_rec_registry
    JOIN main.risk_evaluation AS re
        ON re.risk_eval_registry = tm.match_rec_registry
    WHERE tm.org_spec = 'Lung'
      AND tm.match_status = 'Completed'
),
cer_calculated AS (
    SELECT
        match_id,
        donor_id,
        recipient_id,
        cost_amount / (qol_score * 5.0) AS cer
    FROM cer_base
    WHERE cost_amount IS NOT NULL
      AND qol_score IS NOT NULL
      AND qol_score <> 0
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        match_id,
        donor_id,
        recipient_id,
        cer,
        ntile(20) OVER (ORDER BY cer ASC, match_id ASC) AS cer_group
    FROM cer_calculated
)
SELECT
    cer_group,
    match_id,
    donor_id,
    recipient_id,
    round(cer, 2) AS cost_effectiveness_ratio
FROM ranked
WHERE cer_group IN (1, 20)
ORDER BY cer_group ASC, cer ASC, match_id ASC;

answer:
I used `risk_evaluation.alloc_prio_val` as the database’s explicit allocation-priority/urgency score. Scores are averaged across any repeated match records for the same patient and organ, so each patient-organ pair appears once. “More stable” here means not on ECMO or a VAD; that group includes patients on mechanical ventilation and those with no recorded life support. The gap is the patient’s score minus the average for that organ’s more-stable group.

```sql
WITH patient_organ_scores AS (
    SELECT
        tm.org_spec AS organ,
        tm.recip_ref_reg AS patient_id,
        ri.life_support,
        AVG(re.alloc_prio_val) AS patient_urgency_score
    FROM transplant_matching AS tm
    JOIN recipients_immunology AS ri
      ON ri.immu_recip_registry = tm.recip_ref_reg
    LEFT JOIN risk_evaluation AS re
      ON re.risk_eval_registry = tm.match_rec_registry
    WHERE tm.org_spec IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY
        tm.org_spec,
        tm.recip_ref_reg,
        ri.life_support
),
stable_organ_averages AS (
    SELECT
        organ,
        AVG(patient_urgency_score) AS stable_patient_avg_score
    FROM patient_organ_scores
    WHERE LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(life_support, ''))) NOT IN ('ecmo', 'vad')
    GROUP BY organ
)
SELECT
    p.organ,
    p.patient_id,
    p.life_support,
    ROUND(p.patient_urgency_score, 4) AS patient_urgency_score,
    ROUND(s.stable_patient_avg_score, 4) AS stable_patient_avg_score,
    ROUND(p.patient_urgency_score - s.stable_patient_avg_score, 4) AS score_gap
FROM patient_organ_scores AS p
JOIN stable_organ_averages AS s
  ON s.organ = p.organ
WHERE LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(p.life_support, ''))) IN ('ecmo', 'vad')
ORDER BY
    p.organ,
    p.patient_urgency_score DESC NULLS LAST,
    p.patient_id;
```

```sql
WITH match_scores AS (
    SELECT
        tm.match_rec_registry,
        l.trans_method,
        CAST(regexp_extract(cm.exp_isch_time, '[0-9]+') AS INTEGER)
          + CAST(regexp_extract(cm.exp_time, '[0-9]+') AS INTEGER) AS total_ischemia_time,
        CAST(split_part(d.age_count, ' ', 1) AS INTEGER) AS donor_age,
        CASE
            WHEN left(d.blood_class, 2) = 'AB' THEN 1.0
            WHEN left(d.blood_class, 1) = 'O' THEN 1.0
            WHEN left(r.blood_class, 2) = 'AB' THEN 1.0
            WHEN left(r.blood_class, 1) = left(d.blood_class, 1) THEN 1.0
            ELSE 0.0
        END AS abo_compatibility,
        (CASE WHEN h.hla_a_val <> CAST(json_extract_string(ri.hlaprofile, '$.Hla_A_Val') AS REAL) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
          + (CASE WHEN h.hla_b_val <> CAST(json_extract_string(ri.hlaprofile, '$.Hla_B_Val') AS REAL) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
          + (CASE WHEN h.hla_dr_val <> CAST(json_extract_string(ri.hlaprofile, '$.Hla_Dr_Val') AS REAL) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS hla_mismatches
    FROM transplant_matching tm
    JOIN logistics l
      ON l.log_match_registry = tm.match_rec_registry
    JOIN compatibility_metrics cm
      ON cm.match_comp_registry = tm.match_rec_registry
    JOIN demographics d
      ON d.contrib_registry = cm.donor_ref_reg
    JOIN recipients_demographics r
      ON r.recip_registry = cm.recip_ref_reg
    JOIN hla_info h
      ON h.immu_don_registry = cm.donor_ref_reg
    JOIN recipients_immunology ri
      ON ri.immu_recip_registry = cm.recip_ref_reg
    WHERE lower(trim(tm.match_status)) = 'completed'
),
score_calc AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        0.6 * abo_compatibility + 0.4 * (1 - hla_mismatches / 6.0)
            AS immunological_compatibility_score
    FROM match_scores
)
SELECT
    trans_method,
    ROUND(AVG(total_ischemia_time), 2) AS avg_total_ischemia_time,
    ROUND(
        AVG(
            1.0 / (
                1.0 + exp(
                    -(
                        -0.5
                        + 1.5 * immunological_compatibility_score
                        - 0.02 * donor_age
                    )
                )
            )
        ),
        4
    ) AS avg_expected_graft_survival_score
FROM score_calc
GROUP BY trans_method
ORDER BY avg_expected_graft_survival_score DESC, avg_total_ischemia_time ASC;

There are **73** current (`In Progress`) or completed CMV-positive-donor/CMV-negative-recipient cases. The comparison average below uses all records with known CMV status at the same center, excluding the high-risk D+/R− pairing; infection-risk scores that are unavailable remain `NULL`.

```sql
WITH matches AS (
    SELECT
        tm.match_rec_registry AS match_id,
        lower(tm.match_status) AS status,
        ar.tx_cen_code AS transplant_center,
        lower(json_extract_string(mh.viralstatinfo, '$.Cmv_State')) AS donor_cmv,

    FROM transplant_matching AS tm

    LEFT JOIN administrative_and_review AS ar
        ON ar.adm_rev_registry = tm.match_rec_registry
    LEFT JOIN risk_evaluation AS re
        ON re.risk_eval_registry = tm.match_rec_registry
),
baseline AS (
    SELECT

        round(avg(infection_risk), 4) AS avg_non_mismatched_infection_risk
    FROM matches
    WHERE donor_cmv IS NOT NULL
      AND recipient_cmv IS NOT NULL

)

Using the governed definition of an **Optimal Donor-Recipient Match**—ABO compatible, zero HLA mismatches at A/B/DR, and a BMI-based size compatibility score from 0.9 to 1.1—there are **no qualifying pairs**. The table includes all documented ethnicity categories; every combination has a count of zero.

| Donor ethnicity \ Recipient ethnicity | African | Asian | Caucasian | Hispanic | Other |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| African | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Asian | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Caucasian | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Hispanic | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Other | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 |

```sql
WITH optimal_matches AS (
    SELECT cm.match_comp_registry AS match_id,
           json_extract_string(dem.physicalstats, '$.Ethnicity') AS donor_ethnicity,
           r.ethn_grp AS recipient_ethnicity
    FROM main.compatibility_metrics AS cm
    JOIN main.demographics AS dem
      ON dem.contrib_registry = cm.donor_ref_reg
    JOIN main.recipients_demographics AS r
      ON r.recip_registry = cm.recip_ref_reg
    JOIN main.hla_info AS h
      ON h.immu_don_registry = cm.donor_ref_reg
    JOIN main.recipients_immunology AS ri
      ON ri.immu_recip_registry = cm.recip_ref_reg
    WHERE CASE
        WHEN left(dem.blood_class, 2) = 'AB' THEN TRUE
        WHEN left(dem.blood_class, 1) = 'O' THEN TRUE
        WHEN left(r.blood_class, 2) = 'AB' THEN TRUE
        WHEN left(r.blood_class, 1) = left(dem.blood_class, 1) THEN TRUE
        ELSE FALSE
    END
      AND (
            CASE
                WHEN h.hla_a_val <> CAST(json_extract_string(ri.hlaprofile, '$.Hla_A_Val') AS REAL) THEN 1
                ELSE 0
            END
          + CASE
                WHEN h.hla_b_val <> CAST(json_extract_string(ri.hlaprofile, '$.Hla_B_Val') AS REAL) THEN 1
                ELSE 0
            END
          + CASE
                WHEN h.hla_dr_val <> CAST(json_extract_string(ri.hlaprofile, '$.Hla_Dr_Val') AS REAL) THEN 1
                ELSE 0
            END
      ) = 0
      AND (
          1 - ABS(
              CAST(json_extract_string(dem.physicalstats, '$.Bmi_Value') AS REAL)
              / r.bmi_val - 1
          )
      ) BETWEEN 0.9 AND 1.1
),
counts AS (
    SELECT donor_ethnicity,
           recipient_ethnicity,
           COUNT(match_id) AS match_count
    FROM optimal_matches
    GROUP BY donor_ethnicity, recipient_ethnicity
),
ethnicities AS (
    SELECT 'African' AS ethnicity
    UNION ALL SELECT 'Asian'
    UNION ALL SELECT 'Caucasian'
    UNION ALL SELECT 'Hispanic'
    UNION ALL SELECT 'Other'
),
matrix AS (
    SELECT de.ethnicity AS donor_ethnicity,

I treated “more stable” as patients **not on ECMO or a VAD**, and counted each recipient once per organ. The query returns 317 sick-patient/organ rows. The stable-patient average urgency scores are Heart **3.0444**, Kidney **2.8333**, Liver **2.9768**, Lung **2.8241**, and Pancreas **2.9698**.

```sql
WITH recipient_scores AS (
    SELECT
        c.clin_recip_registry AS recip_id,
        i.life_support,
        0.7 * CASE UPPER(TRIM(COALESCE(c.med_urgency, '')))
            WHEN 'STATUS 1A' THEN 5
            WHEN 'STATUS 1B' THEN 4
            WHEN 'STATUS 2'  THEN 3
            WHEN '2'         THEN 3
            WHEN 'STATUS 3'  THEN 2
            WHEN '3'         THEN 2
            ELSE 1
        END
        + 0.3 * CAST(
            NULLIF(REGEXP_EXTRACT(c.wait_time, '[0-9]+', 0), '')
            AS DOUBLE
        ) / 365.0 AS urgency_score
    FROM clinical AS c
    JOIN recipients_immunology AS i
        ON i.immu_recip_registry = c.clin_recip_registry
),
recipient_organ AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        recip_ref_reg AS recip_id,
        org_spec
    FROM transplant_matching
    WHERE recip_ref_reg IS NOT NULL
      AND org_spec IS NOT NULL
),
patient_organ AS (
    SELECT
        ro.org_spec,
        ro.recip_id,
        rs.life_support,
        rs.urgency_score
    FROM recipient_organ AS ro
    JOIN recipient_scores AS rs
        ON rs.recip_id = ro.recip_id
),
stable_organ_average AS (
    SELECT
        org_spec,
        AVG(urgency_score) AS avg_stable_urgency_score
    FROM patient_organ
    WHERE UPPER(TRIM(COALESCE(life_support, ''))) NOT IN ('ECMO', 'VAD')
    GROUP BY org_spec
)
SELECT
    po.org_spec,
    po.recip_id,
    po.life_support,
    ROUND(po.urgency_score, 4) AS patient_urgency_score,
    ROUND(sa.avg_stable_urgency_score, 4) AS avg_stable_urgency_score,
    ROUND(po.urgency_score - sa.avg_stable_urgency_score, 4)
        AS score_minus_stable_average
FROM patient_organ AS po
JOIN stable_organ_average AS sa
    ON sa.org_spec = po.org_spec
WHERE UPPER(TRIM(COALESCE(po.life_support, ''))) IN ('ECMO', 'VAD')
ORDER BY
    po.org_spec,
    po.urgency_score DESC,
    po.recip_id;

Among completed transplants, **Commercial Air** had the highest average expected graft survival score; **Charter Air** had the lowest average total ischemia time. These are associations by transport method, not evidence that transport method caused the differences.

| Transport method | Avg. total ischemia time (min) | Avg. expected graft survival score |
|---|---:|---:|
| Commercial Air | 596.37 | 0.4593 |
| Ground | 572.27 | 0.4552 |
| Helicopter | 553.84 | 0.4472 |
| Charter Air | 538.90 | 0.4399 |

Sorted by expected graft survival score descending, with ischemia time ascending as the tiebreaker.

```sql
WITH per_match AS (
    SELECT
        logistics.trans_method,
        CAST(regexp_extract(compatibility_metrics.exp_isch_time, '\d+') AS INT)
          + CAST(regexp_extract(compatibility_metrics.exp_time, '\d+') AS INT) AS total_ischemia_time,
        1.0 / (1.0 + exp(-(
          -0.5
          + 1.5 * (
              0.6 * (CASE WHEN (
                  CASE
                    WHEN left((SELECT d.blood_class FROM main.demographics d WHERE d.contrib_registry = compatibility_metrics.donor_ref_reg),2) = 'AB' THEN TRUE
                    WHEN left((SELECT d.blood_class FROM main.demographics d WHERE d.contrib_registry = compatibility_metrics.donor_ref_reg),1) = 'O' THEN TRUE
                    WHEN left((SELECT r.blood_class FROM main.recipients_demographics r WHERE r.recip_registry = compatibility_metrics.recip_ref_reg),2) = 'AB' THEN TRUE
                    WHEN left((SELECT r.blood_class FROM main.recipients_demographics r WHERE r.recip_registry = compatibility_metrics.recip_ref_reg),1) =
                         left((SELECT d.blood_class FROM main.demographics d WHERE d.contrib_registry = compatibility_metrics.donor_ref_reg),1) THEN TRUE
                    ELSE FALSE
                  END
              ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
              + 0.4 * (1 - (
                  (CASE WHEN (SELECT h.hla_a_val FROM main.hla_info h WHERE h.immu_don_registry = compatibility_metrics.donor_ref_reg) <> (SELECT (r.hlaprofile->>'Hla_A_Val')::real FROM main.recipients_immunology r WHERE r.immu_recip_registry = compatibility_metrics.recip_ref_reg) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
                + (CASE WHEN (SELECT h.hla_b_val FROM main.hla_info h WHERE h.immu_don_registry = compatibility_metrics.donor_ref_reg) <> (SELECT (r.hlaprofile->>'Hla_B_Val')::real FROM main.recipients_immunology r WHERE r.immu_recip_registry = compatibility_metrics.recip_ref_reg) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
                + (CASE WHEN (SELECT h.hla_dr_val FROM main.hla_info h WHERE h.immu_don_registry = compatibility_metrics.donor_ref_reg) <> (SELECT (r.hlaprofile->>'Hla_Dr_Val')::real FROM main.recipients_immunology r WHERE r.immu_recip_registry = compatibility_metrics.recip_ref_reg) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
                ) / 6.0)
          )
          - 0.02 * (SELECT CAST(split_part(d.age_count, ' ', 1) AS INT) FROM main.demographics d WHERE d.contrib_registry = compatibility_metrics.donor_ref_reg)
        ))) AS expected_graft_survival_score
    FROM main.transplant_matching
    JOIN main.logistics AS logistics
      ON logistics.log_match_registry = transplant_matching.match_rec_registry
    JOIN main.compatibility_metrics AS compatibility_metrics
      ON compatibility_metrics.match_comp_registry = transplant_matching.match_rec_registry
    WHERE lower(trim(transplant_matching.match_status)) = 'completed'
)
SELECT
    trans_method,
    round(avg(total_ischemia_time), 2) AS avg_total_ischemia_time,
    round(avg(expected_graft_survival_score), 4) AS avg_expected_graft_survival_score
FROM per_match
GROUP BY trans_method
ORDER BY avg_expected_graft_survival_score DESC, avg_total_ischemia_time ASC;

I found **four distinct conditions** in the recorded patient lists, so there isn’t a fifth to report. Counts below are distinct patients; the average is calculated by first averaging each patient’s available surgical-risk scores, so patients with multiple match records are not weighted more heavily.

| Condition | Patients | Average Surgical Risk Score |
|---|---:|---:|
| COPD | 235 | 0.4931 |
| Diabetes | 227 | 0.5159 |
| Heart Disease | 226 | 0.5344 |
| Hypertension | 217 | 0.5069 |

The averages use patients with a recorded surgical risk score; some patients with each condition did not have one. These figures describe the recorded scores and do not by themselves establish that a condition causes higher surgical risk.

```sql
WITH patient_conditions AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    c.clin_recip_registry AS patient_id,
    TRIM(cond) AS condition
  FROM clinical AS c,
       UNNEST(string_split(c.comorbid_detail, ',')) AS t(cond)
  WHERE c.comorbid_detail IS NOT NULL
    AND TRIM(cond) <> ''
),
condition_counts AS (
  SELECT
    condition,
    COUNT(DISTINCT patient_id) AS patient_count
  FROM patient_conditions
  GROUP BY condition
),
patient_risk AS (
  SELECT
    recip_ref_reg AS patient_id,
    AVG(surg_risk_val) AS patient_avg_surgical_risk
  FROM risk_evaluation
  WHERE surg_risk_val IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY recip_ref_reg
),
top_five AS (
  SELECT condition, patient_count
  FROM condition_counts
  ORDER BY patient_count DESC, condition ASC
  LIMIT 5
)
SELECT
  tf.condition,
  tf.patient_count,
  ROUND(AVG(pr.patient_avg_surgical_risk), 4) AS avg_surgical_risk_score
FROM top_five AS tf
JOIN patient_conditions AS pc
  ON pc.condition = tf.condition
LEFT JOIN patient_risk AS pr
  ON pr.patient_id = pc.patient_id
GROUP BY tf.condition, tf.patient_count
ORDER BY tf.patient_count DESC, tf.condition ASC;

I treated `administrative_and_review.tx_cen_code` as the hospital identifier. Each input is the hospital’s average: distance and expected ischemia time for the Logistical Challenge Score; surgical risk and count of listed comorbidities for the Medical Complexity Score. I min–max normalized each input across hospitals, averaged the two inputs in each component score, then averaged those component scores. Missing comorbidity assessments and non-finite surgical-risk values are excluded from their respective averages; hospitals without a usable average for all four inputs are omitted.

| Rank | Hospital | Logistical Challenge | Medical Complexity | Workhorse |
|---:|---|---:|---:|---:|
| 1 | TC917 | 0.7764 | 0.9439 | 0.8602 |
| 2 | TC120 | 0.9613 | 0.6486 | 0.8050 |
| 3 | TC351 | 0.9160 | 0.6924 | 0.8042 |
| 4 | TC463 | 0.8311 | 0.7748 | 0.8030 |
| 5 | TC784 | 0.6527 | 0.9294 | 0.7911 |
| 6 | TC525 | 0.8188 | 0.7250 | 0.7719 |
| 7 | TC193 | 0.6802 | 0.8438 | 0.7620 |
| 8 | TC568 | 0.6350 | 0.8744 | 0.7547 |
| 9 | TC173 | 0.6911 | 0.8131 | 0.7521 |
| 10 | TC702 | 0.9671 | 0.5365 | 0.7518 |

These scores indicate average case challenge, not case volume; some hospital codes may have few matching records.

```sql
WITH hospital_means AS (
  SELECT
    a.tx_cen_code AS hospital,
    avg(try_cast(regexp_extract(cm.distance, '([0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]+)?)', 1) AS DOUBLE))
      AS avg_distance_miles,
    avg(try_cast(regexp_extract(cm.exp_isch_time, '([0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]+)?)', 1) AS DOUBLE))
      AS avg_ischemia_minutes,
    avg(CASE WHEN isfinite(r.surg_risk_val)
             THEN r.surg_risk_val::DOUBLE END) AS avg_surgical_risk,
    avg(CASE
          WHEN c.comorbid_detail IS NOT NULL
           AND trim(c.comorbid_detail) <> ''
          THEN array_length(string_split(c.comorbid_detail, ','))::DOUBLE
        END) AS avg_comorbidities
  FROM administrative_and_review AS a
  LEFT JOIN compatibility_metrics AS cm
    ON cm.match_comp_registry = a.adm_rev_registry
  LEFT JOIN risk_evaluation AS r
    ON r.risk_eval_registry = a.adm_rev_registry
  LEFT JOIN clinical AS c
    ON c.clin_recip_registry = a.adm_rec_ref
  WHERE a.tx_cen_code IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY a.tx_cen_code
),
valid_hospitals AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM hospital_means
  WHERE avg_distance_miles IS NOT NULL
    AND avg_ischemia_minutes IS NOT NULL
    AND avg_surgical_risk IS NOT NULL
    AND avg_comorbidities IS NOT NULL
),
scaled AS (
  SELECT *,
    (avg_distance_miles - min(avg_distance_miles) OVER ())
      / nullif(max(avg_distance_miles) OVER () - min(avg_distance_miles) OVER (), 0)
      AS distance_score,
    (avg_ischemia_minutes - min(avg_ischemia_minutes) OVER ())
      / nullif(max(avg_ischemia_minutes) OVER () - min(avg_ischemia_minutes) OVER (), 0)
      AS ischemia_score,
    (avg_surgical_risk - min(avg_surgical_risk) OVER ())
      / nullif(max(avg_surgical_risk) OVER () - min(avg_surgical_risk) OVER (), 0)
      AS surgical_risk_score,
    (avg_comorbidities - min(avg_comorbidities) OVER ())
      / nullif(max(avg_comorbidities) OVER () - min(avg_comorbidities) OVER (), 0)
      AS comorbidity_score
  FROM valid_hospitals
),
scores AS (
  SELECT
    hospital,
    (distance_score + ischemia_score) / 2 AS logistical_challenge_score,
    (surgical_risk_score + comorbidity_score) / 2 AS medical_complexity_score
  FROM scaled
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    hospital,
    logistical_challenge_score,
    medical_complexity_score,
    (logistical_challenge_score + medical_complexity_score) / 2 AS workhorse_score,
    row_number() OVER (
      ORDER BY (logistical_challenge_score + medical_complexity_score) / 2 DESC,
               hospital ASC
    ) AS rank
  FROM scores
)
SELECT
  rank,
  hospital,
  round(logistical_challenge_score, 4) AS logistical_challenge_score,
  round(medical_complexity_score, 4) AS medical_complexity_score,
  round(workhorse_score, 4) AS workhorse_score
FROM ranked
WHERE rank <= 10
ORDER BY rank;

I treated `tx_cen_code` as the hospital identifier. Each component is min–max normalized across hospitals, with higher values indicating greater challenge: logistical challenge averages normalized distance and expected ischemia time; medical complexity averages normalized surgical risk and comorbidity count. The Workhorse Score is the average of those two scores. The ranking uses cases with all four measures available.

| Rank | Hospital | Logistical Challenge Score | Medical Complexity Score | Workhorse Score |
|---:|---|---:|---:|---:|
| 1 | TC786 | 0.9553 | 0.9019 | 0.9286 |
| 2 | TC917 | 0.7776 | 0.9439 | 0.8608 |
| 3 | TC325 | 0.8018 | 0.9164 | 0.8591 |
| 4 | TC607 | 0.6974 | 0.9149 | 0.8062 |
| 5 | TC120 | 0.9616 | 0.6486 | 0.8051 |
| 6 | TC351 | 0.9160 | 0.6924 | 0.8042 |
| 7 | TC463 | 0.8326 | 0.7748 | 0.8037 |
| 8 | TC784 | 0.6527 | 0.9294 | 0.7911 |
| 9 | TC200 | 0.8025 | 0.7440 | 0.7733 |
| 10 | TC525 | 0.8198 | 0.7250 | 0.7724 |

```sql
WITH parsed AS (
    SELECT
        a.tx_cen_code AS hospital,
        TRY_CAST(regexp_extract(cm.distance, '[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?', 0) AS DOUBLE) AS distance_value,
        TRY_CAST(regexp_extract(cm.exp_isch_time, '[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?', 0) AS DOUBLE) AS ischemia_minutes,
        r.surg_risk_val::DOUBLE AS surgical_risk,
        CASE
            WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(c.comorbid_detail), '') IS NULL THEN NULL
            ELSE 1 + LENGTH(c.comorbid_detail) - LENGTH(REPLACE(c.comorbid_detail, ',', ''))
        END AS comorbidity_count
    FROM transplant_matching tm
    JOIN administrative_and_review a ON a.adm_rev_registry = tm.match_rec_registry
    JOIN compatibility_metrics cm ON cm.match_comp_registry = tm.match_rec_registry
    JOIN risk_evaluation r ON r.risk_eval_registry = tm.match_rec_registry
    JOIN clinical c ON c.clin_recip_registry = tm.recip_ref_reg
    WHERE NULLIF(TRIM(a.tx_cen_code), '') IS NOT NULL
),
complete_cases AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM parsed
    WHERE distance_value IS NOT NULL
      AND ischemia_minutes IS NOT NULL
      AND surgical_risk IS NOT NULL
      AND isfinite(surgical_risk)
      AND comorbidity_count IS NOT NULL
),
hospital_avgs AS (
    SELECT
        hospital,
        AVG(distance_value) AS avg_distance,
        AVG(ischemia_minutes) AS avg_ischemia_minutes,
        AVG(surgical_risk) AS avg_surgical_risk,
        AVG(comorbidity_count) AS avg_comorbidity_count
    FROM complete_cases
    GROUP BY hospital
),
bounds AS (
    SELECT *,
        MIN(avg_distance) OVER () AS min_distance,
        MAX(avg_distance) OVER () AS max_distance,
        MIN(avg_ischemia_minutes) OVER () AS min_ischemia,
        MAX(avg_ischemia_minutes) OVER () AS max_ischemia,
        MIN(avg_surgical_risk) OVER () AS min_surg_risk,
        MAX(avg_surgical_risk) OVER () AS max_surg_risk,
        MIN(avg_comorbidity_count) OVER () AS min_comorbidities,
        MAX(avg_comorbidity_count) OVER () AS max_comorbidities
    FROM hospital_avgs
),
scores AS (
    SELECT
        hospital,
        (
            (CASE WHEN max_distance = min_distance THEN 0.5
                  ELSE (avg_distance - min_distance) / (max_distance - min_distance) END)
            +
            (CASE WHEN max_ischemia = min_ischemia THEN 0.5
                  ELSE (avg_ischemia_minutes - min_ischemia) / (max_ischemia - min_ischemia) END)
        ) / 2.0 AS logistical_challenge_score,
        (
            (CASE WHEN max_surg_risk = min_surg_risk THEN 0.5
                  ELSE (avg_surgical_risk - min_surg_risk) / (max_surg_risk - min_surg_risk) END)
            +
            (CASE WHEN max_comorbidities = min_comorbidities THEN 0.5
                  ELSE (avg_comorbidity_count - min_comorbidities) /
                       (max_comorbidities - min_comorbidities) END)
        ) / 2.0 AS medical_complexity_score
    FROM bounds
)
SELECT
    hospital,
    ROUND(logistical_challenge_score, 4) AS logistical_challenge_score,
    ROUND(medical_complexity_score, 4) AS medical_complexity_score,
    ROUND((logistical_challenge_score + medical_complexity_score) / 2.0, 4) AS workhorse_score
FROM scores
ORDER BY workhorse_score DESC, hospital
LIMIT 10;

answer:
The detailed result is one row per **patient–organ** pairing; a patient may appear under more than one organ. The organ-level stable averages are Heart **3.0444**, Kidney **2.8333**, Liver **2.9768**, Lung **2.8241**, and Pancreas **2.9698**. These averages include patients who are not on ECMO or a VAD (including those on mechanical ventilation), and count each patient once per organ.

The database has no clinical record for some listed patients, so their urgency score and gap are `NULL`; they remain in the list. The query puts scored patients first, in descending urgency-score order within each organ.

```sql
WITH patient_organ_scores AS (
    -- Deduplicate repeated matching records for the same patient and organ.
    SELECT DISTINCT
        tm.recip_ref_reg AS patient_id,
        tm.org_spec AS organ,
        ri.life_support,
        CASE
            WHEN c.clin_recip_registry IS NULL THEN NULL
            ELSE
                0.7 * CASE
                    WHEN c.med_urgency = 'Status 1A' THEN 5
                    WHEN c.med_urgency = 'Status 1B' THEN 4
                    WHEN c.med_urgency IN ('Status 2', '2') THEN 3
                    WHEN c.med_urgency IN ('Status 3', '3') THEN 2
                    ELSE 1
                END
                + 0.3 * (
                    CAST(split_part(c.wait_time, ' ', 1) AS DOUBLE) / 365.0
                )
        END AS urgency_score
    FROM transplant_matching AS tm
    JOIN recipients_immunology AS ri
        ON ri.immu_recip_registry = tm.recip_ref_reg
    LEFT JOIN clinical AS c
        ON c.clin_recip_registry = tm.recip_ref_reg
    WHERE tm.org_spec IS NOT NULL
),
stable_organ_averages AS (
    SELECT
        organ,
        AVG(urgency_score) AS avg_stable_score
    FROM patient_organ_scores
    WHERE upper(trim(COALESCE(life_support, ''))) NOT IN ('ECMO', 'VAD')
    GROUP BY organ
)
SELECT
    p.organ,
    p.patient_id,
    p.life_support,
    ROUND(p.urgency_score, 4) AS patient_urgency_score,
    ROUND(a.avg_stable_score, 4) AS avg_stable_patient_urgency_score,
    ROUND(p.urgency_score - a.avg_stable_score, 4) AS gap_vs_stable_average
FROM patient_organ_scores AS p
JOIN stable_organ_averages AS a
    ON a.organ = p.organ
WHERE upper(trim(COALESCE(p.life_support, ''))) IN ('ECMO', 'VAD')
ORDER BY
    p.organ,
    p.urgency_score DESC NULLS LAST,
    p.patient_id;

    ROUND(p.urgency_score - a.avg_stable_score, 4) AS gap_vs_stable_average
FROM patient_organ_scores AS p
JOIN stable_organ_averages AS a
    ON a.organ = p.organ
WHERE upper(trim(COALESCE(p.life_support, ''))) IN ('ECMO', 'VAD')
ORDER BY
    p.organ,

I used `exp_isch_time` as the total time on ice and converted the recorded distances from miles to kilometers. The ratio is therefore **minutes per kilometer**; a lower ratio indicates faster delivery relative to distance. “Best” is the lowest ratio and “worst” is the highest. Trips under 10 km were excluded.

| Transport method | Average | Best | Worst | Completed transplants |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Ground | 0.2886 | 0.0216 | 1.1354 | 22 |
| Commercial Air | 0.4107 | 0.0704 | 1.5327 | 19 |
| Helicopter | 0.4887 | 0.0524 | 4.8483 | 25 |
| Charter Air | 0.7961 | 0.0334 | 15.4954 | 29 |

```sql
WITH parsed AS (
    SELECT
        l.trans_method,
        TRY_CAST(
            regexp_extract(c.exp_isch_time, '([0-9]+(?:\\.[0-9]+)?)', 1)
            AS DOUBLE
        ) AS ice_minutes,
        TRY_CAST(
            regexp_extract(c.distance, '([0-9]+(?:\\.[0-9]+)?)', 1)
            AS DOUBLE
        ) AS distance_miles
    FROM transplant_matching AS m
    JOIN logistics AS l
        ON l.log_match_registry = m.match_rec_registry
    JOIN compatibility_metrics AS c
        ON c.match_comp_registry = m.match_rec_registry
    WHERE lower(m.match_status) = 'completed'
),
ratios AS (
    SELECT
        trans_method,
        ice_minutes / (distance_miles * 1.609344) AS efficiency_ratio
    FROM parsed
    WHERE ice_minutes IS NOT NULL
      AND distance_miles IS NOT NULL
      AND distance_miles * 1.609344 >= 10
)
SELECT
    trans_method,
    ROUND(AVG(efficiency_ratio), 4) AS avg_efficiency_ratio_min_per_km,
    ROUND(MIN(efficiency_ratio), 4) AS best_efficiency_ratio_min_per_km,
    ROUND(MAX(efficiency_ratio), 4) AS worst_efficiency_ratio_min_per_km,
    COUNT(*) AS completed_transplants
FROM ratios
GROUP BY trans_method
ORDER BY avg_efficiency_ratio_min_per_km;

answer:
I found **282 marginal matches**. All 282 qualify because the donor–patient age gap is over 25 years; **none** have a parsed donor GFR below 40 mL/min/1.73 m².

The schema doesn’t define a separate “Patient Urgency Score.” In the query, I use the available `risk_evaluation.alloc_prio_val` as the urgency-score proxy. It is missing for 38 qualifying matches, so those scores are returned as `NULL` and sorted last.

```sql
WITH parsed AS (
    SELECT
        tm.match_rec_registry,
        tm.donor_ref_reg AS donor_id,
        tm.recip_ref_reg AS patient_id,
        TRY_CAST(regexp_extract(d.age_count, '[0-9]+') AS INTEGER) AS donor_age,
        r.age_count AS patient_age,
        TRY_CAST(
            regexp_extract(f.don_gfr_val, '[0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]+)?')
            AS DOUBLE
        ) AS kidney_gfr,
        re.alloc_prio_val AS alloc_priority
    FROM transplant_matching AS tm
    LEFT JOIN demographics AS d
        ON d.contrib_registry = tm.donor_ref_reg
    LEFT JOIN recipients_demographics AS r
        ON r.recip_registry = tm.recip_ref_reg
    LEFT JOIN function_and_recovery AS f
        ON f.recov_don_registry = tm.donor_ref_reg
    LEFT JOIN risk_evaluation AS re
        ON re.risk_eval_registry = tm.match_rec_registry
),
marginal AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        ABS(donor_age - patient_age) AS age_gap
    FROM parsed
    WHERE ABS(donor_age - patient_age) > 25
       OR kidney_gfr < 40
)
SELECT
    match_rec_registry,
    donor_id,
    patient_id,
    CASE
        WHEN age_gap > 25 AND kidney_gfr < 40 THEN
            CONCAT(
                'Donor-recipient age gap is ', age_gap,
                ' years (>25); donor kidney GFR is ', kidney_gfr,
                ' mL/min/1.73m² (<40).'
            )
        WHEN age_gap > 25 THEN
            CONCAT('Donor-recipient age gap is ', age_gap, ' years (>25).')
        ELSE
            CONCAT(
                'Donor kidney GFR is ', kidney_gfr,
                ' mL/min/1.73m² (<40).'
            )
    END AS marginal_reason,
    CAST(ROUND(alloc_priority::DOUBLE, 4) AS DECIMAL(8, 4))
        AS patient_urgency_score
FROM marginal
ORDER BY patient_urgency_score DESC NULLS LAST,
         patient_id,
         match_rec_registry;

I treated each `tx_cen_code` as a hospital. To make distance, minutes, risk, and illness counts comparable, I min–max normalized each hospital’s average for those measures across hospitals with complete score inputs. The logistical score averages normalized distance and total ischemia time (expected ischemia plus transport); the medical score averages normalized surgical risk and documented comorbidity count. Missing comorbidity assessments are not treated as zero.

| Hospital | Logistical Challenge Score | Medical Complexity Score | Workhorse Score |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| TC786 | 0.8102 | 0.9019 | 0.8561 |
| TC917 | 0.7390 | 0.9439 | 0.8415 |
| TC784 | 0.7355 | 0.9294 | 0.8325 |
| TC120 | 0.9670 | 0.6486 | 0.8078 |
| TC351 | 0.9031 | 0.6924 | 0.7978 |
| TC620 | 0.6503 | 0.9374 | 0.7938 |
| TC463 | 0.7849 | 0.7748 | 0.7798 |
| TC395 | 0.6655 | 0.8894 | 0.7774 |
| TC525 | 0.8235 | 0.7250 | 0.7742 |
| TC189 | 0.6893 | 0.8283 | 0.7588 |

```sql
WITH case_metrics AS (
  SELECT
    ar.tx_cen_code AS hospital,
    TRY_CAST(regexp_extract(cm.distance, '[0-9]+') AS DOUBLE) AS distance_miles,
    TRY_CAST(regexp_extract(cm.exp_isch_time, '[0-9]+') AS DOUBLE)
      + TRY_CAST(regexp_extract(cm.exp_time, '[0-9]+') AS DOUBLE) AS ischemia_minutes,
    CASE
      WHEN re.surg_risk_val IS NOT NULL AND isfinite(re.surg_risk_val)
      THEN re.surg_risk_val::DOUBLE
    END AS surgical_risk,
    CASE
      WHEN cl.comorbid_detail IS NOT NULL
      THEN array_length(string_split(cl.comorbid_detail, ','))::DOUBLE
    END AS comorbidity_count
  FROM administrative_and_review ar
  JOIN compatibility_metrics cm
    ON cm.match_comp_registry = ar.adm_rev_registry
  JOIN risk_evaluation re
    ON re.risk_eval_registry = ar.adm_rev_registry
  JOIN clinical cl
    ON cl.clin_recip_registry = ar.adm_rec_ref
),
hospital_averages AS (
  SELECT
    hospital,
    AVG(distance_miles) AS avg_distance_miles,
    AVG(ischemia_minutes) AS avg_ischemia_minutes,
    AVG(surgical_risk) AS avg_surgical_risk,
    AVG(comorbidity_count) AS avg_comorbidities
  FROM case_metrics
  GROUP BY hospital
),
eligible AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM hospital_averages
  WHERE avg_distance_miles IS NOT NULL
    AND avg_ischemia_minutes IS NOT NULL
    AND avg_surgical_risk IS NOT NULL
    AND avg_comorbidities IS NOT NULL
),
scaled AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    (avg_distance_miles - MIN(avg_distance_miles) OVER ())
      / NULLIF(MAX(avg_distance_miles) OVER () - MIN(avg_distance_miles) OVER (), 0)
      AS distance_score,
    (avg_ischemia_minutes - MIN(avg_ischemia_minutes) OVER ())
      / NULLIF(MAX(avg_ischemia_minutes) OVER () - MIN(avg_ischemia_minutes) OVER (), 0)
      AS ischemia_score,
    (avg_surgical_risk - MIN(avg_surgical_risk) OVER ())
      / NULLIF(MAX(avg_surgical_risk) OVER () - MIN(avg_surgical_risk) OVER (), 0)
      AS surgical_risk_score,
    (avg_comorbidities - MIN(avg_comorbidities) OVER ())
      / NULLIF(MAX(avg_comorbidities) OVER () - MIN(avg_comorbidities) OVER (), 0)
      AS comorbidity_score
  FROM eligible
),
scores AS (
  SELECT
    hospital,
    (distance_score + ischemia_score) / 2.0 AS logistical_challenge_score,
    (surgical_risk_score + comorbidity_score) / 2.0 AS medical_complexity_score,
    (
      (distance_score + ischemia_score) / 2.0
      + (surgical_risk_score + comorbidity_score) / 2.0
    ) / 2.0 AS workhorse_score
  FROM scaled
)
SELECT
  hospital,
  ROUND(logistical_challenge_score, 4) AS logistical_challenge_score,
  ROUND(medical_complexity_score, 4) AS medical_complexity_score,
  ROUND(workhorse_score, 4) AS workhorse_score
FROM scores
ORDER BY workhorse_score DESC, hospital
LIMIT 10;

        WHEN pra_score >= 96 THEN 'Very High'
    END AS pra_group,
    COUNT(*) AS total_patients,
    ROUND(AVG(avg_hla_mismatch), 2) AS avg_hla_mismatch,
    ROUND(AVG(avg_wait_days)) AS avg_wait_days,
    ROUND(AVG(avg_egs), 4) AS avg_egs
FROM patient_outcomes
WHERE pra_score >= 0
GROUP BY pra_group
ORDER BY CASE pra_group
    WHEN 'Low' THEN 1
    WHEN 'Moderate' THEN 2
    WHEN 'High' THEN 3
    WHEN 'Very High' THEN 4
END;

Ground has the lowest average ratio, so it is the most efficient by this measure. Ratios are total ischemia-plus-transport time in minutes per kilometer; lower is better. Distances recorded in miles are converted to kilometers before excluding trips under 10 km.

| Transport method | Average | Best (lowest) | Worst (highest) |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Ground | 0.4375 | 0.0710 | 1.4913 |
| Commercial Air | 0.5864 | 0.1131 | 1.9597 |
| Helicopter | 0.7710 | 0.0718 | 7.5055 |
| Charter Air | 1.4319 | 0.0610 | 29.3987 |

```sql
WITH parsed AS (
    SELECT
        l.trans_method,
        regexp_extract(c.distance, '([0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]+)?)', 1)::DOUBLE AS distance_value,
        lower(c.distance) AS distance_text,
        regexp_extract(c.exp_isch_time, '([0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]+)?)', 1)::DOUBLE AS cold_minutes,
        regexp_extract(c.exp_time, '([0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]+)?)', 1)::DOUBLE AS transport_minutes
    FROM transplant_matching AS tm
    JOIN compatibility_metrics AS c
        ON c.match_comp_registry = tm.match_rec_registry
    JOIN logistics AS l
        ON l.log_match_registry = tm.match_rec_registry
    WHERE lower(trim(tm.match_status)) = 'completed'
),
ratios AS (
    SELECT
        trans_method,
        (cold_minutes + transport_minutes)
            / (distance_value * CASE
                WHEN distance_text LIKE '%mile%' THEN 1.60934
                ELSE 1.0
            END) AS efficiency_ratio,
        distance_value * CASE
            WHEN distance_text LIKE '%mile%' THEN 1.60934
            ELSE 1.0
        END AS distance_km
    FROM parsed
    WHERE cold_minutes IS NOT NULL
      AND transport_minutes IS NOT NULL
      AND distance_value IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
    trans_method,
    ROUND(AVG(efficiency_ratio), 4) AS average_efficiency_ratio_min_per_km,
    ROUND(MIN(efficiency_ratio), 4) AS best_efficiency_ratio_min_per_km,
    ROUND(MAX(efficiency_ratio), 4) AS worst_efficiency_ratio_min_per_km
FROM ratios
WHERE distance_km >= 10
GROUP BY trans_method
ORDER BY AVG(efficiency_ratio);

WITH completed_matches AS (

answer:
The results are grouped by organ and sorted by Patient Urgency Score descending within each organ. In the verified results, the Heart-organ stable-patient average is **3.0444**; the highest-scoring ECMO/VAD patient is **R879266 (VAD)** at **4.2800**, a gap of **1.2356**. The query also returns each patient’s score gap from the corresponding stable-patient average.

```sql
WITH recipient_organ_scores AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        tm.org_spec AS organ,
        tm.recip_ref_reg AS patient_id,
        ri.life_support,
        0.7 * (
            CASE
                WHEN c.med_urgency = 'Status 1A' THEN 5
                WHEN c.med_urgency = 'Status 1B' THEN 4
                WHEN c.med_urgency IN ('Status 2', '2') THEN 3
                WHEN c.med_urgency IN ('Status 3', '3') THEN 2
                ELSE 1
            END
        ) + 0.3 * (
            CAST(split_part(c.wait_time, ' ', 1) AS DOUBLE) / 365.0
        ) AS patient_urgency_score
    FROM main.transplant_matching AS tm
    JOIN main.recipients_immunology AS ri
        ON ri.immu_recip_registry = tm.recip_ref_reg
    JOIN main.clinical AS c
        ON c.clin_recip_registry = tm.recip_ref_reg
    WHERE tm.org_spec IS NOT NULL
),
stable_organ_averages AS (
    SELECT
        organ,
        AVG(patient_urgency_score) AS avg_stable_patient_urgency_score
    FROM recipient_organ_scores
    WHERE life_support IS NULL
       OR life_support NOT IN ('ECMO', 'VAD')
    GROUP BY organ
)
SELECT
    s.organ,
    s.patient_id,
    s.life_support,
    ROUND(s.patient_urgency_score, 4) AS patient_urgency_score,
    ROUND(a.avg_stable_patient_urgency_score, 4) AS avg_stable_patient_urgency_score,
    ROUND(
        s.patient_urgency_score - a.avg_stable_patient_urgency_score,
        4
    ) AS urgency_score_gap
FROM recipient_organ_scores AS s
LEFT JOIN stable_organ_averages AS a
    ON a.organ = s.organ
WHERE s.life_support IN ('ECMO', 'VAD')
ORDER BY s.organ, s.patient_urgency_score DESC, s.patient_id;

The query returns **282 qualifying matches**. In the data, all qualify because their donor–patient age gap exceeds 25 years; none have a renal function score below 40. The urgency score uses the specified status mapping (including noisy `2`/`3` values) and wait time in days divided by 365. The first five results are:

| Match | Donor | Patient | Age gap | Renal score | Patient urgency |
|---|---|---|---:|---:|---:|
| TM397880 | D644697 | R594391 | 28 years | — | 4.2948 |
| TM810395 | D871849 | R637420 | 52 years | 68.00 | 4.2858 |
| TM643174 | D908367 | R902834 | 37 years | 85.00 | 4.2751 |
| TM540327 | D253185 | R541856 | 27 years | 58.00 | 4.2101 |
| TM955460 | D320842 | R541856 | 44 years | 62.00 | 4.2101 |

The query below returns the complete list, sorted by urgency score from highest to lowest.

```sql
WITH parsed AS (
    SELECT
        tm.match_rec_registry,
        tm.donor_ref_reg AS donor_id,
        tm.recip_ref_reg AS patient_id,
        TRY_CAST(regexp_extract(d.age_count, '[0-9]+', 0) AS INTEGER) AS donor_age,
        r.age_count AS patient_age,
        TRY_CAST(regexp_extract(f.don_gfr_val, '[0-9]+(?:\\.[0-9]+)?', 0) AS DOUBLE) AS donor_gfr,
        TRY_CAST(regexp_extract(f.don_crtn_val, '[0-9]+(?:\\.[0-9]+)?', 0) AS DOUBLE) AS donor_creatinine,
        c.med_urgency,
        TRY_CAST(regexp_extract(c.wait_time, '[0-9]+', 0) AS DOUBLE) AS wait_days
    FROM transplant_matching tm
    LEFT JOIN demographics d
        ON d.contrib_registry = tm.donor_ref_reg
    LEFT JOIN recipients_demographics r
        ON r.recip_registry = tm.recip_ref_reg
    LEFT JOIN function_and_recovery f
        ON f.recov_don_registry = tm.donor_ref_reg
    LEFT JOIN clinical c
        ON c.clin_recip_registry = tm.recip_ref_reg
),
evaluated AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        abs(donor_age - patient_age) AS age_gap_years,
        donor_gfr - (10.0 * donor_creatinine) AS renal_score,
        CASE
            WHEN upper(trim(med_urgency)) = 'STATUS 1A' THEN 5
            WHEN upper(trim(med_urgency)) = 'STATUS 1B' THEN 4
            WHEN upper(trim(med_urgency)) IN ('STATUS 2', '2') THEN 3
            WHEN upper(trim(med_urgency)) IN ('STATUS 3', '3') THEN 2
            ELSE 1
        END AS urgency_status_value
    FROM parsed
)
SELECT
    match_rec_registry AS match_id,
    donor_id,
    patient_id,
    age_gap_years,
    round(renal_score, 2) AS renal_function_score,
    concat_ws(
        '; ',
        CASE
            WHEN age_gap_years > 25 THEN
                'Donor-recipient age gap exceeds 25 years ('
                || CAST(age_gap_years AS VARCHAR) || ' years)'
        END,
        CASE
            WHEN renal_score < 40 THEN
                'Renal function score is under 40 ('
                || CAST(round(renal_score, 2) AS VARCHAR)
                || '; eGFR - 10 × creatinine)'
        END
    ) AS marginal_reason,
    round(
        0.7 * urgency_status_value + 0.3 * (wait_days / 365.0),
        4
    ) AS patient_urgency_score
FROM evaluated
WHERE age_gap_years > 25 OR renal_score < 40
ORDER BY patient_urgency_score DESC NULLS LAST, match_rec_registry;

The ratio is **total ischemia time (minutes) ÷ distance (km)**, so a lower value means less time per kilometer. I converted the database’s distance values from miles to kilometers and excluded trips under 10 km. “Best” is the lowest ratio; “worst” is the highest.

| Transport method | Average | Best | Worst |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Ground | 0.4375 | 0.0710 | 1.4913 |
| Commercial Air | 0.5864 | 0.1131 | 1.9597 |
| Helicopter | 0.7710 | 0.0718 | 7.5055 |
| Charter Air | 1.4319 | 0.0610 | 29.3987 |

Ground has the lowest average ratio among these completed matches.

```sql
WITH completed AS (
    SELECT
        l.trans_method,
        CAST(regexp_extract(c.exp_isch_time, '[0-9]+') AS DOUBLE)
          + CAST(regexp_extract(c.exp_time, '[0-9]+') AS DOUBLE) AS total_ice_minutes,
        CAST(regexp_extract(c.distance, '[0-9]+') AS DOUBLE) * 1.60934 AS distance_km
    FROM transplant_matching tm
    JOIN compatibility_metrics c
      ON c.match_comp_registry = tm.match_rec_registry
    JOIN logistics l
      ON l.log_match_registry = tm.match_rec_registry
    WHERE tm.match_status = 'Completed'
),
ratios AS (
    SELECT
        trans_method,
        total_ice_minutes / distance_km AS efficiency_ratio
    FROM completed
    WHERE distance_km >= 10
      AND distance_km > 0
)

answer:
Using CER = estimated transplant cost ÷ (8 × the patient’s quality-of-life score), the average CERs are:

| Medical urgency | Average CER (USD/QALY) |
|---|---:|
| Status 1A | $22,505.34 |
| Status 1B | $8,129.23 |
| Status 2 | $11,126.79 |
| Status 3 | $123,640.13 |

The Status 2 and Status 3 groups include records labeled simply `2` and `3`. Records without a usable cost or a positive quality-of-life score are excluded from the averages.

```sql
WITH completed AS (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN lower(trim(c.med_urgency)) = 'status 1a' THEN 'Status 1A'
      WHEN lower(trim(c.med_urgency)) = 'status 1b' THEN 'Status 1B'
      WHEN lower(trim(c.med_urgency)) IN ('2', 'status 2') THEN 'Status 2'
      WHEN lower(trim(c.med_urgency)) IN ('3', 'status 3') THEN 'Status 3'
      ELSE trim(c.med_urgency)
    END AS urgency,
    try_cast(regexp_replace(cm.cost_est, '[^0-9.]', '', 'g') AS DOUBLE) AS cost,
    r.qol_val
  FROM transplant_matching AS tm
  JOIN clinical AS c
    ON c.clin_recip_registry = tm.recip_ref_reg
  LEFT JOIN compatibility_metrics AS cm
    ON cm.match_comp_registry = tm.match_rec_registry
  LEFT JOIN risk_evaluation AS r
    ON r.risk_eval_registry = tm.match_rec_registry
  WHERE lower(trim(tm.match_status)) = 'completed'
),
cer AS (
  SELECT urgency, cost / (8.0 * qol_val) AS cer
  FROM completed
  WHERE cost IS NOT NULL
    AND qol_val IS NOT NULL
    AND qol_val > 0
)
SELECT
  urgency,
  round(avg(cer), 2) AS average_cer_usd_per_qaly
FROM cer
GROUP BY urgency
ORDER BY CASE urgency
  WHEN 'Status 1A' THEN 1
  WHEN 'Status 1B' THEN 2
  WHEN 'Status 2' THEN 3
  WHEN 'Status 3' THEN 4
  ELSE 5
END,
urgency;

answer:
The criteria return **282 matches**. All 282 qualify because the donor–patient age gap exceeds 25 years; **none** have a calculated renal function score below 40 (the lowest is 45.9432). The highest urgency scores include:

| Match | Donor | Patient | Marginal reason | Patient urgency score |
|---|---|---|---|---:|
| TM397880 | D644697 | R594391 | Age gap >25 years (28 years) | 4.2948 |
| TM810395 | D871849 | R637420 | Age gap >25 years (52 years) | 4.2858 |
| TM643174 | D908367 | R902834 | Age gap >25 years (37 years) | 4.2751 |
| TM955460 | D320842 | R541856 | Age gap >25 years (44 years) | 4.2101 |
| TM540327 | D253185 | R541856 | Age gap >25 years (27 years) | 4.2101 |

The full query sorts numeric urgency scores highest first. **64 matches have no urgency score** because wait-time data is missing; those rows are placed last rather than treating missing wait time as zero.

```sql
WITH base AS (
    SELECT
        tm.match_rec_registry AS match_id,
        tm.donor_ref_reg AS donor_id,
        tm.recip_ref_reg AS patient_id,
        ABS(
            CAST(r.age_count AS INTEGER)
            - TRY_CAST(regexp_extract(d.age_count, '[0-9]+') AS INTEGER)
        ) AS age_gap_years,
        (
            141.0 * pow(
                TRY_CAST(regexp_extract(fr.don_crtn_val, '[0-9.]+') AS DOUBLE) / 0.9,
                -0.411
            ) * pow(
                0.993,
                TRY_CAST(regexp_extract(d.age_count, '[0-9]+') AS DOUBLE)
            )
            - 10.0 * TRY_CAST(regexp_extract(fr.don_crtn_val, '[0-9.]+') AS DOUBLE)
        ) AS renal_function_score,
        0.7 * CASE
            WHEN cl.med_urgency = 'Status 1A' THEN 5
            WHEN cl.med_urgency = 'Status 1B' THEN 4
            WHEN cl.med_urgency IN ('Status 2', '2') THEN 3
            WHEN cl.med_urgency IN ('Status 3', '3') THEN 2
            ELSE 1
        END
        + 0.3 * (
            TRY_CAST(split_part(cl.wait_time, ' ', 1) AS DOUBLE) / 365.0
        ) AS patient_urgency_score
    FROM transplant_matching tm
    JOIN demographics d
        ON d.contrib_registry = tm.donor_ref_reg
    JOIN recipients_demographics r
        ON r.recip_registry = tm.recip_ref_reg
    LEFT JOIN function_and_recovery fr
        ON fr.recov_don_registry = tm.donor_ref_reg
    LEFT JOIN clinical cl
        ON cl.clin_recip_registry = tm.recip_ref_reg
),
selected AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM base
    WHERE age_gap_years > 25
       OR renal_function_score < 40
)
SELECT
    match_id,
    donor_id,
    patient_id,
    CASE
        WHEN age_gap_years > 25 AND renal_function_score < 40 THEN
            'Age gap >25 years (' || age_gap_years ||
            ' years) and renal function score <40 (' ||
            CAST(round(renal_function_score, 2) AS VARCHAR) || ')'
        WHEN age_gap_years > 25 THEN
            'Age gap >25 years (' || age_gap_years || ' years)'
        ELSE
            'Renal function score <40 (' ||
            CAST(round(renal_function_score, 2) AS VARCHAR) || ')'
    END AS marginal_reason,

WITH base AS (

For completed records with `hla_mis_count = 1`, the donor and recipient HLA values differ at **A: 16, B: 16, and DR: 16**. A data inconsistency: all 16 records differ at all three loci, despite being labeled as having exactly one mismatch, so these counts overlap rather than identify a unique mismatched locus per transplant.

```sql
WITH single_mismatch AS (
    SELECT tm.match_rec_registry, tm.donor_ref_reg, tm.recip_ref_reg
    FROM transplant_matching AS tm
    JOIN compatibility_metrics AS cm
      ON cm.match_comp_registry = tm.match_rec_registry
    WHERE lower(trim(tm.match_status)) = 'completed'
      AND cm.hla_mis_count = 1
),
locus_checks AS (
    SELECT
        (don.hla_a_val <> CAST(json_extract_string(ri.hlaprofile, '$.Hla_A_Val') AS REAL)) AS a_mismatch,
        (don.hla_b_val <> CAST(json_extract_string(ri.hlaprofile, '$.Hla_B_Val') AS REAL)) AS b_mismatch,
        (don.hla_dr_val <> CAST(json_extract_string(ri.hlaprofile, '$.Hla_Dr_Val') AS REAL)) AS dr_mismatch
    FROM single_mismatch AS sm
    JOIN hla_info AS don
      ON don.immu_don_registry = sm.donor_ref_reg
    JOIN recipients_immunology AS ri
      ON ri.immu_recip_registry = sm.recip_ref_reg
)
SELECT locus, COUNT(*) AS mismatch_count
FROM locus_checks
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    VALUES ('A', a_mismatch), ('B', b_mismatch), ('DR', dr_mismatch)
) AS v(locus, mismatched)
WHERE mismatched
GROUP BY locus
ORDER BY CASE locus WHEN 'A' THEN 1 WHEN 'B' THEN 2 WHEN 'DR' THEN 3 END;

I treated `tx_cen_code` as the hospital identifier. Each input average is scaled relative to the highest hospital average for that input; each challenge/complexity score is the mean of its two scaled inputs, and Workhorse Score is the mean of those two scores. Hospitals without data for all four inputs are excluded. Cold-ischemia time uses the `exp_isch_time` field.

```sql
WITH match_inputs AS (
    SELECT
        ar.tx_cen_code AS hospital,
        TRY_CAST(regexp_extract(cm.distance, '[0-9]+') AS DOUBLE) AS distance_miles,
        TRY_CAST(regexp_extract(cm.exp_isch_time, '[0-9]+') AS DOUBLE) AS cold_ischemia_minutes,
        re.surg_risk_val AS surgical_risk,
        CASE
            WHEN c.comorbid_detail IS NULL OR trim(c.comorbid_detail) = '' THEN NULL
            ELSE array_length(regexp_split_to_array(c.comorbid_detail, ','))
        END AS comorbidity_count
    FROM main.administrative_and_review AS ar
    JOIN main.transplant_matching AS tm
      ON tm.match_rec_registry = ar.adm_rev_registry
    LEFT JOIN main.compatibility_metrics AS cm
      ON cm.match_comp_registry = tm.match_rec_registry
    LEFT JOIN main.risk_evaluation AS re
      ON re.risk_eval_registry = tm.match_rec_registry
    LEFT JOIN main.clinical AS c
      ON c.clin_recip_registry = tm.recip_ref_reg
    WHERE ar.tx_cen_code IS NOT NULL
), hospital_averages AS (
    SELECT
        hospital,
        AVG(distance_miles) AS avg_distance_miles,
        AVG(cold_ischemia_minutes) AS avg_cold_ischemia_minutes,
        AVG(surgical_risk) AS avg_surgical_risk,
        AVG(comorbidity_count) AS avg_comorbidity_count
    FROM match_inputs
    GROUP BY hospital
), eligible_hospitals AS (
    SELECT
        hospital,
        avg_distance_miles,
        avg_cold_ischemia_minutes,
        avg_surgical_risk,
        avg_comorbidity_count
    FROM hospital_averages
    WHERE avg_distance_miles IS NOT NULL
      AND avg_cold_ischemia_minutes IS NOT NULL
      AND avg_surgical_risk IS NOT NULL
      AND avg_comorbidity_count IS NOT NULL
), normalized AS (
    SELECT
        hospital,
        avg_distance_miles / NULLIF(MAX(avg_distance_miles) OVER (), 0) AS distance_component,
        avg_cold_ischemia_minutes / NULLIF(MAX(avg_cold_ischemia_minutes) OVER (), 0) AS ischemia_component,
        avg_surgical_risk / NULLIF(MAX(avg_surgical_risk) OVER (), 0) AS risk_component,
        avg_comorbidity_count / NULLIF(MAX(avg_comorbidity_count) OVER (), 0) AS comorbidity_component
    FROM eligible_hospitals
), scores AS (
    SELECT
        hospital,
        (distance_component + ischemia_component) / 2.0 AS logistical_challenge_score,
        (risk_component + comorbidity_component) / 2.0 AS medical_complexity_score
    FROM normalized
), ranked AS (
    SELECT
        hospital,
        logistical_challenge_score,
        medical_complexity_score,
        (logistical_challenge_score + medical_complexity_score) / 2.0 AS workhorse_score,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            ORDER BY
                (logistical_challenge_score + medical_complexity_score) / 2.0 DESC,
                hospital
        ) AS ranking
    FROM scores
)
SELECT
    ranking,
    hospital,
    ROUND(logistical_challenge_score, 4) AS logistical_challenge_score,
    ROUND(medical_complexity_score, 4) AS medical_complexity_score,
    ROUND(workhorse_score, 4) AS workhorse_score
FROM ranked
WHERE ranking <= 10
ORDER BY ranking

answer:
The **Logistical Efficiency Ratio** is total ischemia time (expected ischemia time plus transport time) divided by distance in kilometers, in **minutes/km**. I converted the recorded distance from miles to kilometers and excluded trips under 10 km. A **lower** ratio indicates faster delivery relative to distance, so “best” is the minimum and “worst” is the maximum.

| Transport method | Average ratio | Best ratio | Worst ratio |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Ground | 0.4375 | 0.0710 | 1.4913 |
| Commercial Air | 0.5864 | 0.1131 | 1.9597 |
| Helicopter | 0.7710 | 0.0718 | 7.5055 |
| Charter Air | 1.4319 | 0.0610 | 29.3987 |

Ground had the lowest average ratio among the transport methods.

```sql
WITH parsed AS (
    SELECT
        l.trans_method,
        lower(trim(tm.match_status)) AS match_status,
        TRY_CAST(regexp_extract(cm.exp_isch_time, '[0-9]+') AS INTEGER)
            + TRY_CAST(regexp_extract(cm.exp_time, '[0-9]+') AS INTEGER) AS total_ischemia_minutes,
        TRY_CAST(regexp_extract(cm.distance, '[0-9]+') AS DOUBLE) * 1.60934 AS distance_km
    FROM main.transplant_matching AS tm
    JOIN main.compatibility_metrics AS cm
        ON cm.match_comp_registry = tm.match_rec_registry
    JOIN main.logistics AS l
        ON l.log_match_registry = tm.match_rec_registry
), ratios AS (
    SELECT
        trim(trans_method) AS transport_method,
        total_ischemia_minutes / distance_km AS logistical_efficiency_ratio
    FROM parsed
    WHERE match_status = 'completed'
      AND total_ischemia_minutes IS NOT NULL
      AND distance_km >= 10
      AND distance_km IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
    transport_method,
    round(avg(logistical_efficiency_ratio), 4) AS average_efficiency_ratio,
    round(min(logistical_efficiency_ratio), 4) AS best_efficiency_ratio,
    round(max(logistical_efficiency_ratio), 4) AS worst_efficiency_ratio
FROM ratios
GROUP BY transport_method
ORDER BY average_efficiency_ratio;

WITH demand AS (
    SELECT
        a.allc_region AS region,
        r.blood_class AS blood_type,
        COUNT(DISTINCT a.recip_ref_reg) AS patient_count
    FROM allocation_details AS a
    JOIN recipients_demographics AS r
        ON r.recip_registry = a.recip_ref_reg
    GROUP BY a.allc_region, r.blood_class
),
supply AS (
    SELECT
        a.allc_region AS region,
        regexp_extract(d.blood_class, '^(AB|A|B|O)[+-]') AS blood_type,
        COUNT(DISTINCT a.donor_ref_reg) AS donor_count
    FROM allocation_details AS a
    JOIN demographics AS d
        ON d.contrib_registry = a.donor_ref_reg
    GROUP BY
        a.allc_region,
        regexp_extract(d.blood_class, '^(AB|A|B|O)[+-]')
),
regions AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT allc_region AS region
    FROM allocation_details
),
blood_types AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT blood_class AS blood_type
    FROM recipients_demographics
),
counts AS (
    SELECT
        rg.region,
        bt.blood_type,
        COALESCE(de.patient_count, 0) AS patient_count,
        COALESCE(su.donor_count, 0) AS donor_count
    FROM regions AS rg
    CROSS JOIN blood_types AS bt
    LEFT JOIN demand AS de
        ON de.region = rg.region
       AND de.blood_type = bt.blood_type
    LEFT JOIN supply AS su
        ON su.region = rg.region
       AND su.blood_type = bt.blood_type
)
SELECT
    region,
    blood_type,
    patient_count AS patients,
    donor_count AS donors,
    ROUND(patient_count::DOUBLE / NULLIF(donor_count, 0), 4) AS demand_supply_ratio
FROM counts
ORDER BY
    demand_supply_ratio DESC NULLS LAST,
    patients DESC,
    region,
    blood_type;

WITH center_matches AS (
    SELECT
        a.tx_cen_code AS hospital_id,
        t.match_rec_registry AS match_id,
        TRY_CAST(t.created_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS created_at,
        LOWER(TRIM(t.match_status)) AS status
    FROM transplant_matching AS t
    JOIN administrative_and_review AS a
      ON a.adm_rev_registry = t.match_rec_registry
    WHERE a.tx_cen_code IS NOT NULL
),
sequenced AS (

        *,
        LAG(status, 1) OVER (
            PARTITION BY hospital_id
            ORDER BY created_at, match_id
        ) AS prior_status,
        LAG(status, 2) OVER (
            PARTITION BY hospital_id
            ORDER BY created_at, match_id
        ) AS status_two_back
    FROM center_matches
)
SELECT
    hospital_id,
    match_id,
    created_at
FROM sequenced
WHERE status = 'failed'
  AND prior_status = 'failed'
  AND status_two_back IS DISTINCT FROM 'failed'
ORDER BY hospital_id, created_at, match_id;

answer:
The query returns the qualifying matches in descending Patient Urgency Score order. The reason column includes the measured age gap or renal score that triggered the criteria. A `NULL` urgency score means the patient’s clinical data needed for the score is unavailable; those rows sort last. I also excluded donors classified as standard high-risk donors, consistent with the marginal-donor definition.

```sql
WITH match_metrics AS (
    SELECT
        tm.match_rec_registry AS match_id,
        tm.donor_ref_reg AS donor_id,
        tm.recip_ref_reg AS patient_id,
        ABS(rd.age_count - CAST(SPLIT_PART(d.age_count, ' ', 1) AS INTEGER)) AS age_gap_years,
        (141 * POW(CAST(REGEXP_EXTRACT(fr.don_crtn_val, '[0-9.]+') AS DOUBLE) / 0.9, -0.411)
             * POW(0.993, CAST(REGEXP_EXTRACT(d.age_count, '[0-9]+') AS DOUBLE)))
            - (10.0 * CAST(REGEXP_EXTRACT(fr.don_crtn_val, '[0-9.]+') AS DOUBLE)) AS renal_function_score,
        0.7 * (CASE
            WHEN c.med_urgency = 'Status 1A' THEN 5
            WHEN c.med_urgency = 'Status 1B' THEN 4
            WHEN c.med_urgency IN ('Status 2', '2') THEN 3
            WHEN c.med_urgency IN ('Status 3', '3') THEN 2
            ELSE 1
        END) + 0.3 * (CAST(SPLIT_PART(c.wait_time, ' ', 1) AS DOUBLE) / 365.0) AS patient_urgency_score,
        (
            mh.med_history LIKE '%Cancer%'
            OR mh.drug_cond = 'Current use, high risk assessment'
            OR JSON_EXTRACT_STRING(mh.viralstatinfo, 'Hcv_State') = 'Positive'
            OR JSON_EXTRACT_STRING(mh.viralstatinfo, 'Hiv_State') = 'Positive'
        ) AS is_high_risk_donor
    FROM main.transplant_matching tm
    JOIN main.demographics d
        ON d.contrib_registry = tm.donor_ref_reg
    JOIN main.recipients_demographics rd
        ON rd.recip_registry = tm.recip_ref_reg
    LEFT JOIN main.function_and_recovery fr
        ON fr.recov_don_registry = tm.donor_ref_reg
    LEFT JOIN main.clinical c
        ON c.clin_recip_registry = tm.recip_ref_reg
    LEFT JOIN main.medical_history mh
        ON mh.contrib_med_registry = tm.donor_ref_reg
),
eligible AS (
    SELECT
        match_id,
        donor_id,
        patient_id,
        age_gap_years,
        renal_function_score,
        patient_urgency_score,
        CONCAT_WS(
            '; ',
            CASE
                WHEN age_gap_years > 25
                THEN CONCAT('Age gap: ', CAST(age_gap_years AS VARCHAR), ' years (>25)')
            END,
            CASE
                WHEN renal_function_score < 40
                THEN CONCAT(
                    'Renal function score: ',
                    CAST(ROUND(renal_function_score, 2) AS VARCHAR),
                    ' (<40)'
                )
            END
        ) AS marginal_reason
    FROM match_metrics
    WHERE (age_gap_years > 25 OR renal_function_score < 40)
      AND COALESCE(is_high_risk_donor, FALSE) = FALSE
)
SELECT
    match_id,
    donor_id,
    patient_id,
    marginal_reason,
    age_gap_years,
    renal_function_score,
    ROUND(patient_urgency_score, 4) AS patient_urgency_score
FROM eligible
ORDER BY patient_urgency_score DESC NULLS LAST;

Using **Completed** match records as evidence of receipt, I counted each recipient once. For recipients with multiple completed match records, I averaged their match scores before calculating group averages. Nineteen completed recipients had no PRA score, so they could not be assigned to a group.

| PRA group | Patients | Avg. HLA mismatches | Avg. wait (days) | Avg. EGS |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Low | 18 | 2.67 | 459 | 0.4524 |
| Moderate | 98 | 2.53 | 510 | 0.4308 |
| High | 23 | 2.57 | 476 | 0.4301 |
| Very High | 8 | 2.50 | 399 | 0.4927 |

```sql
WITH completed_record_metrics AS (
  SELECT
    tm.recip_ref_reg,
    (
      CASE WHEN hi.hla_a_val <> TRY_CAST(json_extract_string(ri.hlaprofile, '$.Hla_A_Val') AS REAL) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      + CASE WHEN hi.hla_b_val <> TRY_CAST(json_extract_string(ri.hlaprofile, '$.Hla_B_Val') AS REAL) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      + CASE WHEN hi.hla_dr_val <> TRY_CAST(json_extract_string(ri.hlaprofile, '$.Hla_Dr_Val') AS REAL) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
    ) AS hla_mismatch,
    CASE
      WHEN left(d.blood_class, 2) = 'AB'
        OR left(d.blood_class, 1) = 'O'
        OR left(rd.blood_class, 2) = 'AB'
        OR left(rd.blood_class, 1) = left(d.blood_class, 1)
      THEN 1.0
      ELSE 0.0
    END AS abo_compatible,
    CAST(regexp_extract(d.age_count, '[0-9]+') AS INTEGER) AS donor_age,
    CAST(regexp_extract(cl.wait_time, '[0-9]+') AS INTEGER) AS wait_days,
    ri.pra_score
  FROM transplant_matching tm
  JOIN demographics d
    ON d.contrib_registry = tm.donor_ref_reg
  JOIN recipients_demographics rd
    ON rd.recip_registry = tm.recip_ref_reg
  LEFT JOIN hla_info hi
    ON hi.immu_don_registry = tm.donor_ref_reg
  LEFT JOIN recipients_immunology ri
    ON ri.immu_recip_registry = tm.recip_ref_reg
  LEFT JOIN clinical cl
    ON cl.clin_recip_registry = tm.recip_ref_reg
  WHERE lower(trim(tm.match_status)) = 'completed'
),
scored AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    0.6 * abo_compatible + 0.4 * (1.0 - hla_mismatch / 6.0) AS immune_score
  FROM completed_record_metrics
),
patient_summary AS (
  SELECT
    recip_ref_reg,
    pra_score,
    AVG(hla_mismatch) AS avg_hla_mismatch,
    AVG(
      1.0 / (
        1.0 + exp(-(-0.5 + 1.5 * immune_score - 0.02 * donor_age))
      )
    ) AS avg_egs,
    MAX(wait_days) AS wait_days
  FROM scored
  WHERE pra_score IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY recip_ref_reg, pra_score
),
grouped AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    CASE
      WHEN pra_score BETWEEN 0 AND 10 THEN 'Low'
      WHEN pra_score BETWEEN 11 AND 79 THEN 'Moderate'
      WHEN pra_score BETWEEN 80 AND 95 THEN 'High'
      WHEN pra_score >= 96 THEN 'Very High'
    END AS pra_group
  FROM patient_summary
)
SELECT
  pra_group,
  COUNT(*) AS total_patients,
  ROUND(AVG(avg_hla_mismatch), 2) AS avg_hla_mismatch,
  ROUND(AVG(wait_days)) AS avg_wait_days,
  ROUND(AVG(avg_egs), 4) AS avg_egs
FROM grouped
WHERE pra_group IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY pra_group
ORDER BY CASE pra_group
  WHEN 'Low' THEN 1
  WHEN 'Moderate' THEN 2
  WHEN 'High' THEN 3
  WHEN 'Very High' THEN 4
END;

Using **CER = estimated cost ÷ (8 × quality-of-life score)**, the average CERs for completed transplants are:

| Medical urgency status | Average CER (cost per QALY) |
|---|---:|
| Status 1A | $22,505.34 |
| Status 1B | $8,129.23 |
| Status 2 | $11,126.79 |
| Status 3 | $123,640.13 |

Rows without a usable cost or quality-of-life score are excluded from the averages. The urgency values recorded as `2` and `3` are grouped with `Status 2` and `Status 3`, respectively.

```sql
WITH completed_cer AS (
    SELECT
        CASE c.med_urgency
            WHEN 'Status 1A' THEN 'Status 1A'
            WHEN 'Status 1B' THEN 'Status 1B'
            WHEN 'Status 2' THEN 'Status 2'
            WHEN '2' THEN 'Status 2'
            WHEN 'Status 3' THEN 'Status 3'
            WHEN '3' THEN 'Status 3'
        END AS urgency_status,
        CASE c.med_urgency
            WHEN 'Status 1A' THEN 1
            WHEN 'Status 1B' THEN 2
            WHEN 'Status 2' THEN 3
            WHEN '2' THEN 3
            WHEN 'Status 3' THEN 4
            WHEN '3' THEN 4
        END AS urgency_order,
        TRY_CAST(regexp_replace(cm.cost_est, '[^0-9.]', '', 'g') AS DOUBLE)
            / NULLIF(8.0 * re.qol_val, 0) AS cer
    FROM transplant_matching AS tm
    JOIN clinical AS c
        ON c.clin_recip_registry = tm.recip_ref_reg
    LEFT JOIN compatibility_metrics AS cm
        ON cm.match_comp_registry = tm.match_rec_registry
    LEFT JOIN risk_evaluation AS re
        ON re.risk_eval_registry = tm.match_rec_registry
    WHERE lower(trim(tm.match_status)) = 'completed'
)
SELECT
    urgency_status,
    ROUND(AVG(cer), 2) AS average_cer
FROM completed_cer
GROUP BY urgency_status, urgency_order
ORDER BY urgency_order;

FROM ordered

The orbital speed below is calculated from the star’s mass and the planet’s semi-major axis.

```sql
SELECT
    s.hostplname || ' ' || p.completter AS planet_name,
    o.period AS year_length_days,
    o.inclination AS orbital_tilt_deg,
    29.7846918 * sqrt(
        CAST(s.stellarprops->'physical'->>'Mass_Value' AS DOUBLE)
        / o.semimajor
    ) AS orbital_speed_km_s
FROM planets p
JOIN stars s
    ON s.stellarref = p.hostlink
JOIN orbital_characteristics o
    ON o.bodylink = p.planetref

WHERE o.period <= 10
  AND o.inclination > 90
  AND pp.massjup BETWEEN 0.3 AND 13
  AND NULLIF(s.stellarprops->'physical'->>'Mass_Value', '') IS NOT NULL
  AND o.semimajor IS NOT NULL

```sql
WITH demand AS (
    SELECT
        ad.allc_region AS region,
        rd.blood_class AS blood_type,
        COUNT(DISTINCT ad.recip_ref_reg) AS number_of_patients
    FROM main.allocation_details AS ad
    JOIN main.recipients_demographics AS rd
      ON rd.recip_registry = ad.recip_ref_reg
    WHERE ad.allc_region IS NOT NULL
      AND rd.blood_class IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY ad.allc_region, rd.blood_class
),
supply AS (
    SELECT
        ad.allc_region AS region,
        regexp_extract(d.blood_class, '^(AB|A|B|O)[+-]', 0) AS blood_type,
        COUNT(DISTINCT ad.donor_ref_reg) AS number_of_donors
    FROM main.allocation_details AS ad
    JOIN main.demographics AS d
      ON d.contrib_registry = ad.donor_ref_reg
    WHERE ad.allc_region IS NOT NULL
      AND d.blood_class IS NOT NULL
      AND regexp_extract(d.blood_class, '^(AB|A|B|O)[+-]', 0) <> ''
    GROUP BY ad.allc_region, regexp_extract(d.blood_class, '^(AB|A|B|O)[+-]', 0)
),
counts AS (
    SELECT
        COALESCE(demand.region, supply.region) AS region,
        COALESCE(demand.blood_type, supply.blood_type) AS blood_type,
        COALESCE(demand.number_of_patients, 0) AS number_of_patients,
        COALESCE(supply.number_of_donors, 0) AS number_of_donors
    FROM demand
    FULL OUTER JOIN supply
      ON demand.region = supply.region
     AND demand.blood_type = supply.blood_type
)
SELECT
    region,
    blood_type,
    number_of_patients,
    number_of_donors,
    ROUND(number_of_patients::DOUBLE / NULLIF(number_of_donors, 0), 4)
        AS demand_versus_supply_ratio
FROM counts
ORDER BY

WITH center_matches AS (
    SELECT
        ar.tx_cen_code AS hospital_id,
        tm.match_rec_registry AS match_id,
        tm.created_ts AS created_time,
        tm.match_status,
        LAG(tm.match_status, 1) OVER (
            PARTITION BY ar.tx_cen_code
            ORDER BY TRY_CAST(tm.created_ts AS TIMESTAMP), tm.match_rec_registry
        ) AS previous_status,
        LAG(tm.match_status, 2) OVER (
            PARTITION BY ar.tx_cen_code
            ORDER BY TRY_CAST(tm.created_ts AS TIMESTAMP), tm.match_rec_registry
        ) AS status_before_previous

FROM center_matches
WHERE LOWER(TRIM(match_status)) = 'failed'
  AND LOWER(TRIM(previous_status)) = 'failed'
  AND (

      OR LOWER(TRIM(status_before_previous)) <> 'failed'
  )
ORDER BY
    hospital_id,
    TRY_CAST(streak_second_failure_time AS TIMESTAMP),

```sql
WITH stellar_measurements AS (
  SELECT
    hostplname,

  WHERE mass_solar IS NOT NULL
